summary: Third-iteration full-stack testing for Timberline Custom Homes (Gilbert+Burke aesthetic redesign + Resend live). Backend pytest 9/9 PASS including the new happy-path POST /api/contact with rajsoni48879@gmail.com which returned 200 with status:success and a non-empty Resend email_id. Frontend: all 5 routes (/, /portfolio, /our-process, /about, /contact) load with header + footer + Ask Ray widget. Centered logo + split nav verified (PORTFOLIO/OUR PROCESS/ABOUT left, CONTACT + GET A QUOTE pill right). Header transitions from transparent rgba(0,0,0,0) at top to warm-dark rgba(44,41,38,0.92) after scrolling past 80px. Ask Ray floating widget bottom-right opens a card with avatar, call link, message link, Get A Quote CTA, close button — all testids present. Portfolio page renders 6 'View Project' cards. Process page renders 6 zigzag steps with script numerals 1.-6. and titles Initial Consultation / Design & Planning / Permitting & Approvals / Construction / Quality Control & Finishing / Final Walkthrough & Handover. About page shows 200+/30+/20+ stats with 8 office-member-* and 4 field-member-* testids. Contact form happy-path: filled, submitted, contact-success state appeared with send-another-button (real Resend email sent). Mobile hamburger menu opens warm-dark overlay with all nav links and Get A Quote pill. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean, <200 lines, async I/O via asyncio.to_thread for Resend (good).

All required data-testids are present and match the request spec (site-logo, nav-link-portfolio/our-process/about/contact, header-cta-button, ask-ray-toggle/card/close/call/message/cta, contact-form, input-* / select-*, contact-submit-button, contact-success, send-another-button, mobile-menu-toggle, office-member-*, field-member-*).

Resend testing-mode restriction (only delivers to account email) is correctly handled — backend forwards Resend error via 500 + detail; frontend renders contact-error toast. Recommend documenting this restriction in README for future testers.
